answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own wharf record, and its own share of the willow quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The river ledger enforces the limit at intake. The nonce chain allows at most 4 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 3356 identities would post 4668 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
